summary: Final report BW17_0167 for Selverant Therapeutics Inc: hERG automated patch clamp on 40 compounds (Aminoquinazoline). Study summary (benchmark) table on page 1; full compound tables, methods and control results follow.

title_block.title: ST03 ion-channel counterscreen, third chemistry shipment
title_block.subtitle: Final Report

blocks.p: 40 compounds from the Selverant aminoquinazoline series 03 were tested for Selverant Therapeutics Inc in the hERG automated patch clamp. Testing started on 25 May 2017 and results were reported on 14 June 2017. All runs met plate acceptance criteria. 2 of 40 compounds had an IC50 below 1 µM and should be treated as a clear liability. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure.
To rank the screening set for hERG automated patch clamp liability so that Selverant Therapeutics Inc could choose analogues for progression.
40 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one test lot on 25 May 2017 and logged against B-ACC-2017-02854. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client.

HEK293 cells stably expressing hERG (Kv11.1) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells were held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final), with 3-5 minutes per concentration.

list: Plate acceptance: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current amplitude ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
Positive control E-4031 on every run; IC50 must fall within 5-50 nM
IC50 from a four-parameter logistic fit of mean tail-current inhibition; n≥2 cells per compound

blocks.p: All {{PRJ0005:herg.n_tested}} compounds were tested. 2 of 40 compounds had an IC50 below 1 µM and should be treated as a clear liability. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. The median IC50 was {{PRJ0005:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM ({{PRJ0005:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM, {{PRJ0005:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM, {{PRJ0005:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM). E-4031 gave an IC50 of {{PRJ0005:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM, within the acceptance range.

2 of 40 compounds had an IC50 below 1 µM and should be treated as a clear liability. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. These are screening data; binding-site and mechanism statements are outside the scope of this study.
The data support ranking within the set. Recommended next step: progress the compounds with the widest hERG margin and no CYP flag, and confirm any CYP3A4 flags by concentration response.
